351: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਛਪੈ ਕਿਉ ਛਪਿਆ; ਏਕੀ ਏਕੀ ਵੰਡਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੪॥੭॥
Says Nanak: He is said to have shared them out one by one, but though hidden in His creation He cannot stay hidden. ॥4॥7॥
ਕਰਮ ਕਰਤੂਤਿ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਿਸਥਾਰੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
His good conduct is a spreading vine, and it bears the fruit of the Lord's Name.
ਤਿਸੁ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਰੇਖ. ਅਨਾਹਦੁ ਵਾਜੈ; ਸਬਦੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਿ ਕੀਆ ॥੧॥
The Lord, untouched by Maya, sets flowing in him a music of praise that sounds without a break, yet has no form or outline. ॥1॥
If someone comes to know God and keeps on praising Him,
he is the one who drinks the nectar of the Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਪੀਆ. ਸੇ ਮਸਤ ਭਏ ਹੈ; ਤੂਟੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਫਾਹੇ ॥
Those who drank it became absorbed in it; their bonds and nooses broke.
ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਤਾ ਛੋਡੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਲਾਹੇ ॥੨॥
God's light came to rest within them, and they gave up chasing after Maya. ॥2॥
ਸਰਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਰੂਪੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
He saw You, O Lord, in every being, and saw Your Maya at work in all the worlds.
ਰਾਰੈ. ਰੂਪਿ ਨਿਰਾਲਮੁ ਬੈਠਾ; ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਛਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
He sees that God sits apart from this world of strife, and yet watches from within it, present like a reflection. ॥3॥
ਬੀਣਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਜਾਵੈ ਜੋਗੀ; ਦਰਸਨਿ ਰੂਪਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
He is the real yogi who, lost in the sight of the boundless Lord, keeps playing the veena of His praise.
ਸਬਦਿ ਅਨਾਹਦਿ. ਸੋ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
Nanak offers this thought: joined to that unbroken praise, he stays dyed in the love of the Husband-Lord. ॥4॥8॥
ਮੈ ਗੁਣ; ਗਲਾ ਕੇ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰ ॥
My only merit is this: I carry loads of mere talk on my head.
Of all talk, the only good talk is talk of You, O Creator.
My eating, drinking and laughing are all wasted
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਰਿਦੈ; ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਯਾਦਿ ॥੧॥
as long as You do not come to mind in my heart. ॥1॥
Then there is nothing to worry about and no one to depend on,
ਜਨਮਿ ਜਨਮਿ; ਕਿਛੁ ਲੀਜੀ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
if, having come into human birth, we gather what is worth gathering. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The state of our mind is this: it has become a drunken elephant.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੋਲੀਐ; ਸਭੁ ਖਤੋ ਖਤਾ ॥
Whatever we say is wrong, all wrong.
With what face can we even offer a prayer,
when our good and our bad both stand by as witnesses? ॥2॥
ਜੈਸਾ ਤੂੰ ਕਰਹਿ; ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋ ਹੋਇ ॥
As You make a person, so he becomes.
Besides You there is no one else.
ਜੇਹੀ ਤੂੰ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਹਿ; ਤੇਹੀ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Whatever understanding You give, that is what a person receives.
As it pleases You, so You keep the world running. ॥3॥
The finest ragas and the whole family of their raginis:
if the supreme nectar of the Name arises among them,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ; ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮਾਲੁ ॥
O Nanak, that is the wealth which brings one to the Creator,
if only someone grasps this thought. ॥4॥9॥
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ. ਅਪਨੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਤਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਖੀਆ. ਕਾਜੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
When in His kindness my Husband-Lord came to settle in His own home, my companions gathered and began the songs of union.
ਖੇਲੁ ਦੇਖਿ; ਮਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ; ਸਹੁ ਵੀਆਹਣ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
My Husband has come to marry me; seeing this, joy has risen in my mind. ॥1॥
Sing, O women, sing again and again the song that awakens discernment.
ਹਮਰੈ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ; ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਭਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The Husband who is the life of the world has come to dwell in my home. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੈ. ਹਮਰਾ ਵੀਆਹੁ ਜਿ ਹੋਆ; ਜਾਂ ਸਹੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਤਾਂ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
By coming to the Guru's refuge my marriage took place; when I met my Husband, I understood
ਤਿਹੁ ਲੋਕਾ ਮਹਿ. ਸਬਦੁ ਰਵਿਆ ਹੈ; ਆਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੨॥
that He pervades the whole world as its life-current; my sense of self went, and my mind settled in Him. ॥2॥
ਆਪਣਾ ਕਾਰਜੁ. ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ; ਹੋਰਨਿ. ਕਾਰਜੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
He treats this work as His own and completes it Himself; no one else can bring it about.
ਜਿਤੁ ਕਾਰਜਿ, ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਦਇਆ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ. ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
From this union come service, contentment, compassion and right living; only one turned towards the Guru understands this. ॥3॥
ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਪਿਰੁ. ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
Says Nanak: though the one God is the Husband of all,
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧੦॥
she alone is the fortunate bride on whom He casts His glance of grace. ॥4॥10॥
To him home and forest are alike, for he lives in steadiness and in love of God;
his wrong thinking goes, and praise of God takes its place.
The eternal Name is on his lips, and by this true ladder,
352: walking the path the true Guru shows, he reaches the place that stays his own for ever. ॥1॥
One who brings his mind under control has, as it were, mastered the six Shastras;
he sees God's light fully present in all beings. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
But if a person has great thirst for Maya and puts on many religious garbs,
the distress that Maya breeds drives the peace out of him,
and lust and anger steal the wealth of the Name within.
The one who gives up being in two minds and stays joined to the Name crosses over. ॥2॥
He praises God and enjoys the happiness of inner steadiness;
he makes the love of Gobind his friend and companion.
He is sure that God Himself creates and God Himself bestows.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ; ਆਗੈ ਜਿੰਦੁ ॥੩॥
His body, mind and very life he keeps handed over to God. ॥3॥
Falsehood and other vices seem to him the root of great suffering for the body,
and all religious garbs and castes look like dust.
He is sure that whatever is born comes and goes;
O Nanak, only God's Name is lasting. ॥4॥11॥
There is one pool, the gathering of the holy, and in it lovely lotuses, the saints.
It keeps them always in bloom and gives them fragrance and beauty.
The swans, the saints, pick and eat its bright pearls,
and stay a part of the all-powerful Master of the world. ॥1॥
Everything that is seen is born and perishes,
ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਸਰਵਰਿ; ਕਮਲੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
but the lotus in the pool is not without water, and is not seen to perish. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Only a rare person understands this secret.
The Veda, too, speaks always of the world of the three qualities.
One whose awareness stays merged in understanding the word of God's praise
walks the path the true Guru shows and reaches the highest state. ॥2॥
He is free of Maya, absorbed in God, and remembers Him with love;
joined to the King of kings, he is always glad at heart.
The one You protect in Your mercy, O Lord, is saved;
You carry even stone-hearted ones across in the boat of Your Name. ॥3॥
ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਣਿਆ ॥
He saw God's light in the three worlds and knew Him as dwelling in all the world;
ਉਲਟ ਭਈ; ਘਰੁ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਆਣਿਆ ॥
his awareness turned back from Maya, and he brought God's dwelling into his own heart.
Day and night he worships with his attention fixed.
Nanak falls at the feet of such people. ॥4॥12॥
One who holds firmly to the Guru's teaching is rid of his lack of faith.
Much cleverness of one's own gathers dirt in the mind.
That gathered dirt is removed only through the Name of the eternal Lord,
and only by the Guru's grace can a person keep his attention fixed on God. ॥1॥
God is always present beside us; pray to Him with a single mind.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ; ਸਾਚੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Know for certain that the Creator knows every being's pain and pleasure. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who earns what is worthless keeps coming and going;
there is no end to his empty talk.
ਕਿਆ ਦੇਖਾ; ਸੂਝ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
He has not seen what is real, so he gains no understanding,
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਮਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥੨॥
and without the Name his mind finds no peace. ॥2॥
All who are born stay in the grip of disease,
tormented by the pain of pride and of attachment to Maya.
ਸੇ ਜਨ ਬਾਚੇ; ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Only those people escape whom God Himself protects,
who walk the path the true Guru shows and taste the nectar of the Name. ॥3॥
One who tastes the nectar of the Name and keeps the restless mind in check,
who walks by the Guru's teaching and utters the life-giving word of praise,
gains through that true word freedom from vice and a high spiritual state,
and, O Nanak, rids himself of pride from within. ॥4॥13॥
ਜੋ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ; ਸੋ ਸਚੁ ਥੀਆ ॥
The one whom God made His own became the very image of the eternal Lord.
The true Guru gave him the life-giving Name.
The Name lives in his heart, and his mind is never parted from God;
day after day he keeps the company of the Beloved. ॥1॥
O Lord, the person You keep in Your refuge
353: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
tastes Your Name by the Guru's grace, and gains in the Name what is to him the nine treasures. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who holds the eternal Name to be the highest deed and duty,
to him I am always a sacrifice.
ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
Those who are dyed in God's love are the ones accepted in His presence;
in their company the most precious treasure is found. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ. ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਆ; ਧਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
Fortunate is the soul-bride who has found God as her Husband,
who is dyed in His love and reflects on the word of His praise.
She crosses over herself and, in her company, carries her family across;
walking the path the true Guru shows, she keeps the real gain of human birth before her eyes. ॥3॥
May Your eternal Name be my caste and lineage,
and true love for You my religious deeds, my duty and my discipline.
O Nanak, the one God blesses is not asked for any account;
every thought of another is wiped out, and he sees the One alone. ॥4॥14॥
Many are born, and having come they simply go.
Some, dyed in God's love, stay absorbed in remembering Him.
ਇਕਿ ਧਰਨਿ ਗਗਨ ਮਹਿ; ਠਉਰ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
Some find no place of rest anywhere on earth or in the sky;
ਸੇ ਕਰਮਹੀਣ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
they are the unfortunate ones who do not remember God's Name. ॥1॥
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ; ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
The way of the higher spiritual life is learnt from the perfect Guru.
ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ. ਬਿਖੁ ਵਤ ਅਤਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ; ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ. ਹਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਲੰਘਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
This world is a deadly, poisonous whirlpool; God takes a person across it by joining him to the Guru's word. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ; ਆਪਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਲਿ ॥
Those whom God Himself joins to Him
ਤਿਨ ਕਉ; ਕਾਲੁ. ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਪੇਲਿ ॥
cannot be brought down by the fear of death.
Turned towards the Guru, those dear ones stay pure
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਅੰਭ ਊਪਰਿ; ਕਮਲ ਨਿਰਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
just as lotuses stay untouched in the water. ॥2॥
ਬੁਰਾ ਭਲਾ; ਕਹੁ ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
Whom can we call bad, and whom good,
when God is seen living in everyone? Yet the eternal One is found only by turning towards the Guru.
God is beyond description; only by taking the Guru's teaching can I speak of Him and reflect on Him.
Only by staying in the Guru's company can I reach the far shore. ॥3॥
To study the many distinctions of the Shastras, Vedas and Smritis
and to bathe at the sixty-eight holy places is this: to enjoy the Lord's Name in the heart.
Turned towards the Guru, life stays pure and no dirt of vice clings to it.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ; ਵਡੇ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥
O Nanak, the Name lives in the heart only when grace comes from God on high. ॥4॥15॥
ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਪਾਇ ਲਗਉ ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ; ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
Again and again I fall at my Guru's feet; I have seen the Lord living within me.
ਕਰਤ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ. ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਰਵਿਆ; ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਖਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
Reflecting on His qualities, I remember God in my heart; in my heart I see Him and ponder His praises. ॥1॥
Remember the Lord's Name; remembrance carries a person across.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ. ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਭੈ; ਮਿਟੈ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ. ਹੋਇ ਉਜੀਆਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
When by the Guru's grace the jewel of God's Name is found, ignorance goes and there is light. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਰਵਨੀ ਰਵੈ. ਬੰਧਨ ਨਹੀ ਤੂਟਹਿ; ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ. ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
One who only talks with his tongue does not have his bonds broken; caught in pride, his wandering does not end.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਹਉਮੈ ਤੂਟੈ; ਤਾ ਕੋ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
Only on meeting the true Guru is pride broken, and only then is a person accepted. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ. ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ; ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
One who remembers God's Name, is devoted to the Beloved, and keeps that Ocean of peace in his heart
ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ ਦਾਤਾ; ਮਤਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
is carried across through the Guru's teaching by the Lord who loves devotion, the Life of the world, the Giver of good understanding. ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝਿ ਮਰੈ. ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਏ; ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥
One who fights hard with his own mind and dies to pride, dissolving the mind's cravings within the mind itself, finds God.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਗਜੀਵਨੁ; ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੧੬॥
O Nanak, the one on whom the Life of the world has mercy stays joined to Him with a steady heart. ॥4॥16॥
ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਕਹਹਿ. ਸੁਣਾਵਹਿ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ; ਕਿਸੁ ਸਮਝਾਵਹਿ. ਸਮਝਿ ਰਹੇ ॥
Those who have come to understand do not tell, announce or explain themselves to anyone.
ਕਿਸੈ ਪੜਾਵਹਿ. ਪੜਿ ਗੁਣਿ ਬੂਝੇ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ. ਸੰਤੋਖਿ ਰਹੇ ॥੧॥
Those who have read, reflected and understood do not parade their learning; joined to the true Guru's word, they live in contentment. ॥1॥
354: By the Guru's teaching, the One who pervades all bodies,
ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ. ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that unfathomable, great-hearted Lord: worship Him, O my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Countless waves of love and devotion for God rise within them.
Those who keep company with God's praises day after day live pure lives.
The life of the worldly person wrapped up in Maya goes to waste.
The person devoted to God stays unattached. ॥2॥
The body of one who sings God's praises stays pure;
knowing his own real self, he keeps his attention fixed on God.
He becomes one with the Lord who is the beginning of all, boundless, beyond the beyond, priceless as a diamond.
His mind, once the prey of "mine", is dyed in love of the ruby-like Lord and grows steady. ॥3॥
Those who only talk of wisdom are spiritually dead.
ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਦੂਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਤੂੰ ਹੈ ॥
God is not far from them, and for them You, O Lord, are everywhere,
they see the whole world as the spread of Maya,
O Nanak, who have remembered the Name with the support of the Guru's teaching. ॥4॥17॥
Some beggar lives on what he begs,
some king is lost in his kingship.
One receives honour, another is dishonoured.
Another builds plans in his mind and knocks them down, lost in such thoughts.
But no one is greater than You, O Lord;
I can point to no one who became good by himself. ॥1॥
For me Your Name is the only support;
You are the Giver, able to do all things, the Creator. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
I cannot find the right road; I go astray,
and there is no place for me to sit in Your presence.
ਮਨ ਕਾ ਅੰਧੁਲਾ; ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਬੰਧੁ ॥
Blind in mind, I stay tied up in Maya,
and my body is always being worn down and ruined.
I keep building great hopes of eating more and living longer,
though my every breath and morsel is on Your account. ॥2॥
Day and night God gives the blind one a lamp,
and cares for the one drowning in the world-ocean.
Those who repeat the Name, hear it and have faith in it,
to them I am a sacrifice.
Nanak makes this one prayer at Your door:
our life and body rest entirely on Your support. ॥3॥
ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਜਪੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
Only when You give it can I repeat Your Name
and find a place to sit in Your presence.
ਜਾਂ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
Only when it pleases You can my wrong thinking go
and the jewel of wisdom come to live in my mind.
The person on whom God casts His glance of grace meets the true Guru
and, Nanak humbly says, crosses the world-ocean. ॥4॥18॥
ਦੁਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਧੇਨੁ. ਪੰਖ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੰਖੀ; ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ. ਉਤਭੁਜ ਕਾਮਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
What use is a cow without milk? A bird without wings is helpless, and plants cannot stay green without water.
ਕਿਆ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ. ਸਲਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਾ; ਅੰਧੀ ਕੋਠੀ. ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
What kind of king is he whom no one salutes? So too the heart without Your Name is a dark cell. ॥1॥
Why do You forget me, O Lord? When You are forgotten, great suffering comes upon me.
ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ; ਤੂੰ ਵਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Suffering comes; O Lord, do not slip from my mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਅਖੀ ਅੰਧੁ. ਜੀਭ ਰਸੁ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕੰਨੀ. ਪਵਣੁ ਨ ਵਾਜੈ ॥
The eyes grow dim, the tongue loses its taste, the ears no longer catch a sound,
ਚਰਣੀ ਚਲੈ. ਪਜੂਤਾ ਆਗੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਫਲ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੨॥
and the feet move only when someone leads with a stick in front; still he stays without remembrance, and his life bears other fruit. ॥2॥
ਅਖਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਬਾਗ, ਭੁਇ ਚੋਖੀ; ਸਿੰਚਿਤ ਭਾਉ ਕਰੇਹੀ ॥
Those who plant the trees of the Guru's word in the clean soil of the heart and water them with love
ਸਭਨਾ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਏਕੋ; ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮਾ. ਕੈਸੇ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੩॥
all bear the one fruit, the Name; but without God's grace no one receives it. ॥3॥
ਜੇਤੇ ਜੀਅ. ਤੇਤੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੇਰੇ; ਵਿਣੁ ਸੇਵਾ. ਫਲੁ ਕਿਸੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
All these beings are Yours, O Lord; without remembering You no one gains the fruit of life.
ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਭਾਣਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜੀਉ ਰਹੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੪॥
Pain and pleasure come by Your will; without the support of the Name the soul cannot stay steady. ॥4॥
ਮਤਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਮਰਣੁ. ਜੀਵਣੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੈਸਾ; ਜਾ ਜੀਵਾ ਤਾਂ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
To die to self within the Guru's teaching is the true life, and any other life is worthless; if I live for self, that is no proper way to live.
355: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜੀਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਆ; ਜਹ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੁ ਤੁਹੀ ॥੫॥੧੯॥
Says Nanak: the Lord is the giver of life; keep us, O Lord, wherever it pleases You. ॥5॥19॥
The human body kept free of vice is the true Brahmin, and the purified mind is his loincloth;
deep acquaintance with God is the sacred thread, and attention fixed on His feet the ring of kusha grass.
I beg only for God's Name and His praise as my offering,
so that by the Guru's grace I may stay absorbed in God. ॥1॥
O Pandit, reflect on God's qualities in this same way.
ਨਾਮੇ ਸੁਚਿ. ਨਾਮੋ ਪੜਉ; ਨਾਮੇ ਚਜੁ ਆਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Purity lies in the Name; the Name is what I read; in the Name are all religious rites. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਬਾਹਰਿ ਜਨੇਊ; ਜਿਚਰੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
The outward sacred thread lasts only as long as the light dwells in the body.
Keep the Lord's Name in your heart: this is the loincloth and this the frontal mark.
The Name alone stands by you here and hereafter.
ਵਿਣੁ ਨਾਵੈ; ਹੋਰਿ ਕਰਮ. ਨ ਭਾਲਿ ॥੨॥
Do not go seeking other rites, forgetting the Name. ॥2॥
Burn the love of Maya out of yourself entirely: this is the worship of the deity.
See the one God everywhere, and seek no other deity.
One who recognises the all-pervading God has, as it were, entered trance at the tenth gate.
One who keeps the Lord's Name ever on his lips is reading the true reflections of the scriptures. ॥3॥
Love for the Lord's feet is the food offering; through it the mind's wandering ends and fear departs.
With the radiance of the Lord the watchman lit within, no thief of lust or the like comes near.
One who forms a deep bond with the one God has, as it were, the frontal mark on his forehead.
One who recognises the Lord dwelling within learns to tell good deeds from bad. ॥4॥
God cannot be won over by rites alone,
nor is His worth found by reading the scriptures.
ਅਸਟ ਦਸੀ ਚਹੁ; ਭੇਦੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
The One whose secret the eighteen Puranas and the four Vedas did not find,
O Nanak, the true Guru has shown Him to us everywhere. ॥5॥20॥
He alone is the true servant, slave and devotee
who, facing the Guru, becomes the Lord's slave.
ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਾਜੀ; ਤਿਨਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
He knows that the Lord who created this world destroys it again,
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ; ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
and that apart from Him there is no other like Him. ॥1॥
Reflecting on the eternal Name through the Guru's word,
those who face the Guru are honoured in the court of the eternal Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The plea and prayer made while facing the Guru are the true plea and prayer;
the Master of the mansion hears it and gives His approval,
from His eternal throne He calls that servant,
and the Lord, who can do all things, grants him honour. ॥2॥
O Lord, the Gurmukh has Your strength alone and You alone as his support;
the Guru's word is his lasting warrant;
he accepts God's will and leaves the world with honour,
and by the true warrant of the Guru's word no vice blocks his way. ॥3॥
The Pandits read the Veda and expound it to others,
but do not know the secret that the treasure of the Name is within.
ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ; ਸੋਝੀ ਬੂਝ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
This understanding does not come without the Guru,
that the eternal Lord pervades everyone. ॥4॥
What can I say of facing the Guru, and what can I tell of it?
O Lord of all wonders, You alone know this secret.
O Nanak, for the Gurmukh there is only the Lord's one door and support,
where remembrance, made while facing the Guru, stays the prop of his life. ॥5॥21॥
ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਹੇਲੀ; ਉਪਜੈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
The body is a house of sorrows, like an unbaked clay pot: it is born, suffers and then perishes.
ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਦੁਤਰੁ. ਕਿਉ ਤਰੀਐ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ. ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
This world is an ocean hard to cross; how can one get across? Without the Guru, God, no one reaches the far shore. ॥1॥
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ. ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਹਰੇ ॥
O my dear Lord, I have no support but You; apart from You I have no one.
ਸਰਬੀ ਰੰਗੀ ਰੂਪੀ ਤੂੰਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ. ਜਿਸੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You are present in all colours and all forms; He forgives the one on whom He casts His gracious glance. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਾਸੁ ਬੁਰੀ. ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ, ਨ ਦੇਵੈ; ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਿਲਣ. ਨ ਦੇਇ, ਬੁਰੀ ॥
The wicked mother-in-law, Maya, does not let me stay in my heart's home; the wretch does not let me meet my Husband.
ਸਖੀ ਸਾਜਨੀ ਕੇ. ਹਉ ਚਰਨ ਸਰੇਵਉ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਨਦਰਿ ਧਰੀ ॥੨॥
I serve the feet of my companions in the holy company; by the Guru's grace the Lord casts His gracious glance on me. ॥2॥
356: ਆਪੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਖਿਆ; ਤੁਮ ਸਾ ਮੀਤੁ. ਨ ਅਵਰੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
O Lord, when I reformed myself, subdued my mind and looked, I saw there is no friend like You.
ਜਿਉ ਤੂੰ ਰਾਖਹਿ. ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹਣਾ; ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
As You keep us, so we live; You give sorrow and comfort, and whatever You do comes to pass. ॥3॥
ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਦੋਊ ਬਿਨਾਸਤ; ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਭਈ ॥
In the Guru's refuge, hope and craving for Maya are both destroyed, and one stays free of the hopes of Maya's three qualities.
ਤੁਰੀਆਵਸਥਾ. ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਲਹੀ ॥੪॥
The state that Maya cannot touch is reached by following the Guru, when the shelter of the holy company is taken. ॥4॥
ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਭਿ ਜਪ ਤਪ; ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਵਾ ॥
One in whose heart the unseen, unfathomable Lord dwells has, as it were, all knowledge, meditation, chanting and austerity.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪਾਏ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੫॥੨੨॥
O Nanak, following the Guru's teaching the mind is dyed in the Lord's Name and remembers Him in stillness of mind. ॥5॥22॥
Attachment breeds a sense of ownership of family; attachment drives all the world's work;
but attachment breeds vices, so give up attachment. ॥1॥
ਮੋਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਤਜਹੁ; ਤੁਮੑ ਬੀਰ ॥
O brother, give up attachment and end the wandering of the mind.
ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਿਦੇ ਰਵੈ ਸਰੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only then can a person remember the eternal Name in his heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਜਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
When a person gains the nine treasures of the eternal Name,
the son, his mind, no longer weeps or pines for Maya, the mother. ॥2॥
In this attachment the whole world is drowned;
only a rare one who walks the Guru's path crosses over. ॥3॥
Caught in this attachment, you will fall into births again and again;
gripped by attachment, you will go to the land of Death. ॥4॥
ਗੁਰ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਲੇ; ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
Those who take instruction from a customary guru and practise chanting and austerity,
ਨਾ ਮੋਹੁ ਤੂਟੈ; ਨਾ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੫॥
their attachment does not break, nor are they accepted by the Lord. ॥5॥
ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ; ਤਾ ਏਹੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
The one on whom the Lord casts His gracious glance is rid of this attachment.
O Nanak, he stays ever absorbed in God. ॥6॥23॥
The eternal, unseen, infinite Lord Himself does all that happens.
O Lord, I am a sinner, yet You are the forgiver. ॥1॥
All that happens in the world is what pleases You, O Lord.
A person who acts by the stubbornness of his own mind is ruined in the end. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The intellect of one who follows his own mind stays caught in the love of Maya,
and, missing the Lord's remembrance, it suffers for some evil deed. ॥2॥
Give up evil thinking and earn some spiritual profit;
be sure that whatever is born is born of the unseen, unfathomable Lord. ॥3॥
Such is our Friend, ever ready to help.
Whoever meets the Guru, the Guru impresses on him devotion to God. ॥4॥
In all worldly dealings there is only loss;
O Nanak, but not for one whose mind loves the Lord's Name. ॥5॥24॥
Only when one with learning does good to others has he truly become thoughtful through it.
ਜਾਂ ਪੰਚ ਰਾਸੀ; ਤਾਂ ਤੀਰਥ ਵਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
Dwelling at places of pilgrimage bears fruit only when the five passions are subdued. ॥1॥
Playing the ankle bells bears fruit only if my mind is attached to the Lord's feet;
ਤਉ ਜਮੁ. ਕਹਾ ਕਰੇ; ਮੋ ਸਿਉ ਆਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
then what can Death do to me hereafter? ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
One who has turned from all hopes of Maya is truly a renunciate.
ਜਾਂ ਜਤੁ ਜੋਗੀ; ਤਾਂ ਕਾਇਆ ਭੋਗੀ ॥੨॥
If one keeps the yogi's continence while a householder, know him for a true householder. ॥2॥
One with compassion who reflects on keeping the body pure is the true Digambar, the naked Jain;
one dead to vice himself is the true non-violent one, who kills no other. ॥3॥
O Lord, You are One, and all these are Your many guises.
ਏਕ ਨ. ਭਰੀਆ; ਗੁਣ ਕਰਿ ਧੋਵਾ ॥
I am not stained by a single fault that I could wash away by growing virtues;
ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ; ਹਉ ਨਿਸਿ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥
my Husband stays awake while I have slept all through the night of my life. ॥1॥
How then can I be dear to my Husband?
ਸਹੁ ਜਾਗੈ; ਹਉ ਨਿਸ ਭਰਿ ਸੋਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
My Husband stays awake while I sleep all night. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
357: I come to the bed of my heart, yet I am still parched with thirst for worldly hopes.
ਆਗੈ ਸਹ ਭਾਵਾ; ਕਿ ਨ ਭਾਵਾ ॥੨॥
How can I be sure whether I please my Husband or not? ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ; ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇਗਾ. ਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
O mother, I do not know what will become of me,
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ; ਰਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
and without the sight of the Lord I find no comfort. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰੇਮੁ. ਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ; ਮੇਰੀ ਤਿਸ. ਨ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ॥
I never tasted my Husband's love, so my thirst for Maya was not quenched.
My youth has gone, and now my soul repents. ॥3॥
Even now, if I wake from the thirst of Maya's hopes,
and live detached and free of those hopes, He may yet be kind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
When the soul-bride sheds her pride and so adorns herself,
then the Husband comes and meets her on the bed of her heart. ॥4॥
O Nanak, only then is she pleasing to the Husband's mind,
ਛੋਡਿ ਵਡਾਈ; ਅਪਣੇ ਖਸਮ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੨੬॥
when, giving up self-importance, she merges in her Master's will. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥26॥
Caught in the world's attachment, her parents' home, the soul-bride stays very foolish.
ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹ ਕੀ ਮੈ; ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
So I did not know the worth of that Husband. ॥1॥
ਸਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ; ਦੂਜਾ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ॥
My Husband is ever the same; there is no other like Him.
He ever casts His gracious glance, and by it alone can I meet Him. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The soul-bride who leaves the world's attachment for the Lord's feet, her in-laws' home, recognises the worth of the eternal Lord;
steady in stillness of mind and in love, she forms a deep bond with her Husband. ॥2॥
When by the Guru's grace such understanding comes to her,
then the soul-bride becomes pleasing to the Husband's mind. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ; ਭੈ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
Says Nanak: the soul-bride who makes awe and love of God her adornment,
on the bed of her heart the Husband abides for ever. ॥4॥27॥
ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕਾ ਪੂਤੁ; ਨ ਕਿਸ ਕੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
In truth neither son nor mother is anyone's lasting companion.
Yet through false attachment the world wanders and goes astray. ॥1॥
O my Master, I am created by You.
ਜਾਂ ਤੂੰ ਦੇਹਿ; ਜਪੀ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only when You give me Your Name can I repeat it. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Even with many sins, if someone pleads at His door,
when it pleases Him, He forgives. ॥2॥
By the Guru's grace our evil thinking is destroyed.
Wherever I look, I see the one God pervading. ॥3॥
Says Nanak: when a person comes to such understanding,
that God is seen everywhere, he stays absorbed in the eternal Lord. ॥4॥28॥
ਤਿਤੁ ਸਰਵਰੜੈ. ਭਈਲੇ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ; ਪਾਣੀ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤਿਨਹਿ ਕੀਆ ॥
We dwell in that dreadful lake in which the Lord Himself has made the fire of craving in place of water;
ਪੰਕਜੁ ਮੋਹ. ਪਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਚਾਲੈ; ਹਮ ਦੇਖਾ. ਤਹ ਡੂਬੀਅਲੇ ॥੧॥
in the mud of attachment the foot cannot move, and before our eyes many are drowning. ॥1॥
ਮਨ. ਏਕੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਸਿ; ਮੂੜ ਮਨਾ ॥
O mind, O foolish mind, you do not remember the One Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਤ; ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The more you forget the Lord, the more your virtues waste away. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਨਾ ਹਉ ਜਤੀ ਸਤੀ. ਨਹੀ ਪੜਿਆ; ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
O Lord, I am neither celibate nor chaste nor learned; my life is that of the foolish and ignorant.
ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਨੑ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ; ਜਿਨੑ ਤੂੰ. ਨਾਹੀ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੯॥
Nanak prays: keep me in the refuge of those who have not forgotten You. ॥2॥29॥
ਛਿਅ ਘਰ. ਛਿਅ ਗੁਰ; ਛਿਅ ਉਪਦੇਸ ॥
There are six schools of philosophy, six founders and six doctrines,
but the root Guru of them all is One; they are His many guises. ॥1॥
The house of the holy company where the Creator's praises are sung,
ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖੁ; ਵਡਾਈ ਤੋਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
hold on to that house; in it lies your greatness. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਵਿਸੁਏ ਚਸਿਆ ਘੜੀਆ ਪਹਰਾ; ਥਿਤੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਮਾਹੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
Just as there are seconds, minutes, hours, watches, lunar days, weekdays, months and many seasons,
yet the sun is one and these are all its forms,
so, O Nanak, the Creator has countless forms. ॥2॥30॥
358: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਲਖ ਲਸਕਰ. ਲਖ ਵਾਜੇ ਨੇਜੇ; ਲਖ ਉਠਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਲਾਮੁ ॥
If you had armies in their lakhs, lakhs of drummers and lancers, and lakhs rising to salute you,
ਲਖਾ ਉਪਰਿ. ਫੁਰਮਾਇਸਿ ਤੇਰੀ; ਲਖ ਉਠਿ. ਰਾਖਹਿ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
if your rule ran over lakhs and lakhs rose to show you respect,
ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ. ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭਿ ਨਿਰਾਫਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥
yet if this honour is not accepted before God, all your deeds are in vain. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ; ਜਗੁ ਧੰਧਾ ॥
Without the Lord's Name, attachment to the world becomes nothing but entanglement.
ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਸਮਝਾਈਐ ਭੋਲਾ; ਭੀ ਸੋ ਅੰਧੋ ਅੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
However much the mind is taught, it stays blind, utterly blind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਲਖ ਖਟੀਅਹਿ. ਲਖ ਸੰਜੀਅਹਿ ਖਾਜਹਿ; ਲਖ ਆਵਹਿ. ਲਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
If lakhs of rupees are earned, lakhs amassed and spent, lakhs come in and lakhs go out,
ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ. ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਜੀਅ ਕਿਥੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
yet if this honour is not accepted in the Lord's sight, their owners stay troubled within. ॥2॥
ਲਖ ਸਾਸਤ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ; ਲਖ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੜਹਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ॥
The scriptures may be expounded lakhs of times, and scholars may read the Puranas lakhs of times,
ਜਾਂ ਪਤਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਨਾ ਪਵੈ; ਤਾਂ ਸਭੇ ਕੁਪਰਵਾਣ ॥੩॥
yet if this honour is not accepted at the Lord's door, all that reading is in vain. ॥3॥
ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ. ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ; ਕਰਮਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
Honour comes only through the eternal Name, and the Creator's Name is gained by His own grace.
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜੇ ਵਸੈ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੧॥
O Nanak, if the Name dwells in the heart day and night, by His grace one finds the far shore. ॥4॥1॥31॥
ਦੀਵਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ; ਦੁਖੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇਲੁ ॥
The one Name is my lamp, and into it I have poured the oil of sorrow.
ਉਨਿ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਓਹੁ ਸੋਖਿਆ; ਚੂਕਾ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਲੁ ॥੧॥
By that light the oil is burned away, and my dealings with Death come to an end. ॥1॥
O people, do not mock my words.
ਲਖ ਮੜਿਆ ਕਰਿ ਏਕਠੇ; ਏਕ ਰਤੀ ਲੇ ਭਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Heap up lakhs of loads of wood and set one tiny spark to them: all turns to ash. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪਤਲਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੇਸਉ ਕਿਰਿਆ; ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾਰੁ ॥
For me the Lord's Name is the rice ball on the leaf plate, and the Creator's true Name is my funeral rite.
ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਆਗੈ ਪਾਛੈ; ਏਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Here, hereafter and everywhere, this is the support of my life. ॥2॥
ਗੰਗ ਬਨਾਰਸਿ. ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ; ਨਾਵੈ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਉ ॥
O Lord, Your praise is my Ganges and Benares; in it my soul bathes.
ਸਚਾ ਨਾਵਣੁ ਤਾਂ ਥੀਐ; ਜਾਂ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਭਾਉ ॥੩॥
True bathing comes only when love for the Lord's feet stays day and night. ॥3॥
ਇਕ ਲੋਕੀ ਹੋਰੁ ਛਮਿਛਰੀ; ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਵਟਿ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਖਾਇ ॥
The Brahmin rolls rice balls, offers one to the gods and another to the ancestors, and then eats himself.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਿੰਡੁ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਕਾ; ਕਬਹੂੰ ਨਿਖੂਟਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੨॥
O Nanak, the rice ball of God's grace never runs out. ॥4॥2॥32॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ; ਦੂਖ ਭੂਖ ਤੀਰਥ ਕੀਏ ॥
Even the gods, to see You, bore pain and hunger and went on pilgrimages.
ਜੋਗੀ ਜਤੀ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਤੇ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਵੇ ਭੇਖ ਭਏ ॥੧॥
Many yogis and celibates, keeping their disciplines, went about in ochre robes. ॥1॥
O Master, for Your sake many stay dyed in Your love.
ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਅਨੇਕਾ. ਰੂਪ ਅਨੰਤਾ; ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ. ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕੇਤੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Many are Your names, endless Your forms; Your virtues are countless and cannot be told. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰ ਘਰ ਮਹਲਾ ਹਸਤੀ ਘੋੜੇ; ਛੋਡਿ ਵਿਲਾਇਤਿ ਦੇਸ ਗਏ ॥
Leaving doors and homes, palaces, elephants and horses, they left their own lands.
ਪੀਰ ਪੇਕਾਂਬਰ. ਸਾਲਿਕ ਸਾਦਿਕ; ਛੋਡੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਥਾਇ ਪਏ ॥੨॥
Many pirs, prophets, men of knowledge and men of faith abandoned the world to be accepted at Your door. ॥2॥
ਸਾਦ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਰਸ ਕਸ ਤਜੀਅਲੇ; ਕਾਪੜ ਛੋਡੇ ਚਮੜ ਲੀਏ ॥
Many gave up the world's tastes, comforts, ease and all savoury things, and left clothes to wear skins.
ਦੁਖੀਏ ਦਰਦਵੰਦ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ; ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਦਰਵੇਸ ਭਏ ॥੩॥
Many, like the suffering and the anguished, became mendicants to plead at Your door and stay dyed in Your Name. ॥3॥
ਖਲੜੀ ਖਪਰੀ ਲਕੜੀ ਚਮੜੀ; ਸਿਖਾ ਸੂਤੁ ਧੋਤੀ ਕੀਨੑੀ ॥
Some took a leather pouch, some a begging bowl, some a staff, some a deerskin; some wore topknot, sacred thread and loincloth.
ਤੂੰ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ. ਹਉ ਸਾਂਗੀ ਤੇਰਾ; ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜਾਤਿ ਕੈਸੀ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੩॥
Nanak prays: You are my Master and I am only Your player in guise; what pride of caste can I have? ॥4॥1॥33॥
359: One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Deep within my mind the five passions lie hidden;
ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਹਿ; ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਹਿ ਉਦਾਸੇ ॥੧॥
they run about as if frightened and never stay still. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰਾ; ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ. ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹੈ ॥
My mind does not stay fixed in the remembrance of the merciful Lord.
ਲੋਭੀ ਕਪਟੀ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀ; ਮਾਇਆ ਅਧਿਕ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Maya has a strong hold on it, and it has become greedy, deceitful, sinful and hypocritical. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
Like a bride awaiting her husband, my body says: I will put a garland of flowers round my neck,
and when my Beloved meets me, then I will adorn myself. ॥2॥
My five companions, the senses, whose husband is the soul,
are busy only with the body's pleasures, though the soul must depart. ॥3॥
At the parting the five companions together can only weep,
ਸਾਹੁ ਪਜੂਤਾ; ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ. ਲੇਖਾ ਦੇਹਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੪॥
and, says Nanak, the soul alone is seized to render its account. ॥4॥1॥34॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਮਨੁ ਮੋਤੀ ਜੇ ਗਹਣਾ ਹੋਵੈ; ਪਉਣੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੂਤ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
If the soul-bride makes her mind an ornament like a pure pearl, and each breath of remembrance the thread,
ਖਿਮਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ. ਕਾਮਣਿ ਤਨਿ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਰਾਵੈ ਲਾਲ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
and wears forbearance as the adornment of her body, she becomes dear to her Beloved and meets Him. ॥1॥
O Beloved of many virtues, the soul-bride who fixes her mind on Your virtues
ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ; ਹੋਹਿ ਨ ਅਵਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
finds Your virtues in no other. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਾਰੁ. ਕੰਠਿ ਲੇ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਦਾਮੋਦਰੁ ਦੰਤੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
If she wears constant remembrance of God as a necklace round her neck and uses His remembrance as tooth powder,
ਕਰ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਤਾ. ਕੰਗਨ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਧਰੇਈ ॥੨॥
and wears the Creator's devotion as bracelets on her hands, in this way her mind stays fixed at His feet. ॥2॥
ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨੁ ਕਰ ਮੁੰਦਰੀ ਪਹਿਰੈ; ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਪਟੁ ਲੇਈ ॥
If she wears the Lord's praise as a ring on her finger and takes His shelter as the silk that guards her honour,
ਧੀਰਜੁ. ਧੜੀ ਬੰਧਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ; ਸ੍ਰੀਰੰਗੁ. ਸੁਰਮਾ ਦੇਈ ॥੩॥
uses composure to dress her hair, and puts the Name of Lakshmi's Lord in her eyes as collyrium; ॥3॥
ਮਨ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਜੇ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਜਾਲੇ; ਕਾਇਆ ਸੇਜ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
if she lights the lamp of knowledge in the palace of her mind and makes her heart a bed,
ਗਿਆਨ ਰਾਉ. ਜਬ ਸੇਜੈ ਆਵੈ; ਤ ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩੫॥
O Nanak, when the Lord, giver of knowledge, appears on that bed, He unites her with Himself. ॥4॥1॥35॥
ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਕਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਭਾਈ ॥
O brother, what is in a creature's power? He does only what God makes him do.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣਾ. ਸੋ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ; ਕੀਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੧॥
A creature's cleverness is of no use; whatever the Lord wishes to do, He is doing. ॥1॥
O Lord, the one who pleases You finds Your will sweet.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਾ ਕਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਾਈ; ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Nanak, that one receives honour who stays absorbed in the eternal Master's Name. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਪਇਆ. ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ. ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
According to the impressions of past deeds etched in our minds, our life's warrant is written, and no force prevails against it.
ਜੈਸਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ. ਤੈਸਾ ਪੜਿਆ; ਮੇਟਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
As that record of life is written, so it unfolds; no one can erase it by his own effort. ॥2॥
ਜੇ ਕੋ ਦਰਗਹ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਬੋਲੈ; ਨਾਉ ਪਵੈ ਬਾਜਾਰੀ ॥
If anyone keeps objecting at length against this command, he only earns the name of a braggart.
ਸਤਰੰਜ ਬਾਜੀ ਪਕੈ ਨਾਹੀ; ਕਚੀ ਆਵੈ ਸਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
Life is like a game of chaupar: played against His will it cannot be won, and the pieces stay unripe. ॥3॥
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
On this path no learned Pandit is wise for his learning, nor is any unlettered fool bad for his lack of it.
ਬੰਦੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਕਰਾਏ; ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਹੀਐ ਬੰਦਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੩੬॥
He alone can be called a true servant whom the Lord keeps in His will and makes sing His praises. ॥4॥2॥36॥
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ. ਮਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਮੁੰਦ੍ਰਾ; ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਿਮਾ ਹਢਾਵਉ ॥
O yogi, I keep the Guru's word in my mind as my earrings, and I wear forbearance as my patched coat.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੈ. ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਉ; ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
Whatever God does I accept as being for the good, and so gain stillness of mind, the treasure of yoga. ॥1॥
360: ਬਾਬਾ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਜੀਉ, ਜੁਗਹ ਜੁਗ ਜੋਗੀ; ਪਰਮ ਤੰਤ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਗੰ ॥
The one joined to the Lord's feet is truly joined, the real yogi whose trance never breaks;
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗਿਆਨ ਕਾਇਆ ਰਸ ਭੋਗੰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whoever has gained the life-giving Name of the Lord beyond Maya enjoys in his heart the bliss of deep knowing of God. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਿਵ ਨਗਰੀ ਮਹਿ, ਆਸਣਿ ਬੈਸਉ; ਕਲਪ ਤਿਆਗੀ ਬਾਦੰ ॥
I too sit on my seat: leaving the mind's fancies and worldly quarrels, I settle in the land of the gracious Lord.
ਸਿੰਙੀ ਸਬਦੁ. ਸਦਾ ਧੁਨਿ ਸੋਹੈ; ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਨਾਦੰ ॥੨॥
The Guru's word within me is my horn, its sweet note always sounding; day and night my mind plays the Guru's word. ॥2॥
ਪਤੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ. ਗਿਆਨ ਮਤਿ. ਡੰਡਾ; ਵਰਤਮਾਨ ਬਿਭੂਤੰ ॥
Reflection on His virtues is my begging bowl, a mind deeply joined to God my staff, and seeing Him present everywhere my ashes.
ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ. ਰਹਰਾਸਿ ਹਮਾਰੀ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਅਤੀਤੰ ॥੩॥
The Lord's praise is my code of yoga; staying turned to the Guru is our path, which keeps us detached from Maya. ॥3॥
ਸਗਲੀ ਜੋਤਿ, ਹਮਾਰੀ ਸੰਮਿਆ; ਨਾਨਾ ਵਰਨ ਅਨੇਕੰ ॥
Seeing God's light in all beings, in their many colours and forms, is my yogi's crutch,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਲਿਵ ਏਕੰ ॥੪॥੩॥੩੭॥
O Nanak, say: listen, Bharthari yogi, this is what holds us fixed in the Supreme Lord alone. ॥4॥3॥37॥
ਗੁੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਧਿਆਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਧਾਵੈ; ਕਰਿ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
Make deep knowing of God your molasses, attention fixed on Him your flowers, and noble conduct the bark, and mix them;
ਭਾਠੀ ਭਵਨੁ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਕਾ ਪੋਚਾ; ਇਤੁ ਰਸਿ ਅਮਿਉ ਚੁਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
burn your attachment to the body as the still, and make love for the Lord the cooling cloth; from this mixture the nectar of life will flow. ॥1॥
ਬਾਬਾ. ਮਨੁ ਮਤਵਾਰੋ, ਨਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵੈ; ਸਹਜ ਰੰਗ ਰਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
O yogi, the truly drunken mind is the one that drinks the essence of the Name and stays rapt in the joy of stillness,
ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਬਨੀ. ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਸਬਦੁ ਅਨਾਹਦ ਗਹਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
whose love for the Lord's feet lasts day and night, and who keeps the Guru's word ever steady within. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਸਾਚੁ. ਪਿਆਲਾ ਸਹਜੇ; ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪੀਆਏ, ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥
This is the cup whose intoxication lasts; the Lord, master of all virtues, gives it in stillness to the one on whom He looks with grace.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਹੋਵੈ; ਕਿਆ ਮਦਿ ਛੂਛੈ ਭਾਉ ਧਰੇ ॥੨॥
One who becomes a trader in this life-giving essence has no love for your shallow wine. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ. ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ; ਪੀਵਤ ਹੀ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
One who drinks the Guru's life-giving word of teaching is accepted by God as soon as he drinks;
ਦਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਕਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੈ ਕਰੈ ਕਿਆ ॥੩॥
he comes to love the sight of the Lord's door, and needs neither liberation nor paradise. ॥3॥
ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਾ. ਸਦ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ; ਜੂਐ ਜਨਮੁ ਨ ਹਾਰੈ ॥
One dyed in His praise stays ever detached from Maya and does not lose his life as in a gamble;
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੁਣਿ ਭਰਥਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ; ਖੀਵਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੪॥੩੮॥
O Nanak, say: listen, Bharthari yogi, he stays drunk on the life-giving bliss. ॥4॥4॥38॥
Babar handed over Khurasan to another and struck terror into Hindustan.
ਆਪੈ. ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਈ ਕਰਤਾ; ਜਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਲੁ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
The Creator does not let blame fall on Himself; He sent the Mughal Babar up as the angel of death.
ਏਤੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਈ ਕਰਲਾਣੇ; ਤੈਂ. ਕੀ ਦਰਦੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
So much beating fell that the people cried out in anguish; did You feel no pity for them? ॥1॥
O Creator, You take care of all beings.
ਜੇ ਸਕਤਾ ਸਕਤੇ ਕਉ ਮਾਰੇ; ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਰੋਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
If a strong man strikes another strong man, no one feels grief or grievance in his mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
